name: align-whitespace
note: Forced breaks interact with alignment and white-space: under text-align: right the line before the br sits at the right edge and the last line at its own edge (no justification of br-terminated lines); under white-space: nowrap the br still forces a break (forced breaks apply in every white-space mode); under pre the br behaves like a newline; under pre-line collapsed spaces around the br vanish.
